title_zh: 打虎！江西省省长叶建春被查
title_en: Jiangxi Governor Ye Jianchun Investigated for Discipline Violations
summary_zh: 据中央纪委国家监委网站8月27日消息，江西省委副书记、省长叶建春涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: According to the CCDI website on August 27, Ye Jianchun, Deputy Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Committee and Governor of Jiangxi Province, is suspected of serious disciplinary and legal violations and is under investigation.
body_zh:
据中央纪委国家监委网站8月27日消息，江西省委副书记、省长叶建春涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
